 Rachel Burrows passed away on Sunday just hours before her mother, Lady Jennifer Morrow.
 Wife and daughter of former Fermanagh MLA pass away
 Posted: 11:23 am November 16, 2026 
 SHARE 
 [whatsapp] 
 Share this... 
 Facebook Pinterest Twitter Linkedin 
 TRIBUTES have been paid to the wife and daughter of DUP Chairman and former Fermanagh-South Tyrone MLA Lord Maurice Morrow who passed away just hours apart on Sunday.
 Lady Jennifer Morrow and her daughter Rachel Burrows had both been battling illness for some time.
 In a statement from DUP Leader Gavin Robinson, he extended the party’s deepest sympathy to Lord Morrow.
 Advertisement 
 “Words cannot adequately express the heartbreak and sorrow felt across our Party at the devastating news that our Party Chairman, Lord Morrow, has lost both his beloved daughter Rachel and his dear wife Jennifer within hours of each other yesterday,” said Mr Robinson.
 “On behalf of the Democratic Unionist Party, I extend our deepest sympathy to Maurice, to Rachel’s husband John, and to the entire Morrow and Burrows families at this most difficult of times.
 “Maurice Morrow has been a rock of strength and support to so many of us through difficult moments in our lives. Now, in his darkest hour, it is our turn to be a rock for him.”
 ‘No words’ 
 “Throughout Jennifer and Rachel’s long battles, Maurice has demonstrated extraordinary love and strength,” Mr Robinson continued.
 “I know that his deep Christian faith has sustained him through those difficult days, but I also know that today his heart is breaking as a husband, a father and a grandfather.
 “There are no words that can ease the pain of such an unimaginable loss.
 Advertisement 
 “But Maurice and his family should know that they will be supported by the prayers of their many friends and colleagues across Northern Ireland.
 “We pray that the Lord will draw especially near to Maurice, John and the entire family, and grant them the strength and peace that only He can give in the days ahead.”
 In a social media post, Donaghey Primary School in Dungannon, where Mrs Burrows previously worked as a classroom assistant, offered their deepest condolences.
 “As a school we are absolutely devastated to have learned of the passing of Rachel Burrows after her long battle with illness,” they said.
 “Rachel and John’s children, Jack and Isla are past pupils of Donaghey Primary School.
 “In recent years, Rachel had at one time been a much valued classroom assistant in our P1/P2 class.
 “In this role, Rachel’s warmth and personality shone, as it did at the school gate.
 “Her support of our school was deeply appreciated and it was always a pleasure to engage with Rachel.
 “Our deepest condolences go to John, Jack and Isla along with the wider family circle.”
 Ms Burrows’ funeral will take place on Wednesday at 1pm at Carland Presbyterian Church.
 Lady Morrow’s funeral details have not yet been confirmed.
